question: Should this repository accept Fuse.js 7.5.0’s corrected scoring and ranking behavior for existing knowledge-base searches?
rationale: The lockfile update is mechanically coherent and CI is green, but only a maintainer can decide whether changed relevance ordering is acceptable product behavior for existing users.

options.title: Validate representative searches before merging
options.body: Run representative knowledge-base queries against 7.4.2 and 7.5.0, then merge when the corrected ordering is acceptable.

options.title: Accept the upstream ranking correction
options.body: Merge with the known possibility that some existing query scores and result order will change.

options.title: Defer the update
options.body: Keep the current resolution until a planned relevance evaluation can establish the desired behavior.

recommendation.title: Validate representative searches before merging
recommendation.body: Run representative knowledge-base queries against 7.4.2 and 7.5.0, then merge when the corrected ordering is acceptable.
